shared_elements: low-relief figures carved in profile/frontal outline
long horizontal linear elements crossing the field
quadruped animal forms with legs indicated

multiple figures distributed across a single panel
justification: Both surfaces carry several carved figures spread over one panel, with elongated horizontal lines running across the field and quadruped/limbed creatures, but at the level of specifics they diverge sharply: A shows a hierarchically registered composition of naturalistically modelled birds in a row, a zigzag band, canid and long-necked bird in profile, while B shows crudely schematic frontal anthropomorphs with raised arms and splayed legs interspersed with bars. The rendering conventions differ too — rounded, volumetric relief with anatomical detail versus flat, stick-like grooved outlines — so the correspondence is of the generic kind any relief tradition could produce independently.
